top_stories.title: Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate
top_stories.description: Perplexity Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 are open-weight decision models that return probabilities, not text. Version 1.3 adds Locate for span extraction and reports 91.6% mean accuracy on 63 query-classification tasks. top_stories.title: Inside this quantum computer, memory vibrates like a guitar string
top_stories.description: Researchers have created a quantum computer that stores information in microscopic vibrations, potentially making quantum machines smaller, more powerful, and better at preserving information. The breakthrough successfully demonstrated advanced quantum calculations and could help overcome major barriers to practical quantum computing.
